candidates.reason: The Solstice logo is reduced to an unreadable dot in dead space. The reading order is scrambled: headline, then CTA, then subcopy squeezed to the right of the button. The headline wraps into a cramped two-line block jammed into the top-left corner.

This is effectively the same as candidate 1. The logo is lost as a stray dot, the CTA sits between the headline and its own subcopy, and the subcopy is crammed against the right edge with a 3-line wrap.
It keeps the original left-to-right order, but the headline is oversized and its 'light' almost touches the Shop Now button. The logo wordmark is tiny and illegible, and the subcopy is very small.

This is the most faithful arrangement: logo, then headline over subcopy, then CTA, with even gaps and a clear hierarchy. But the Solstice wordmark and subcopy are too small to read at 320x50, and the headline is slightly underweighted for the format.
